comment: Demo data for Scenario 01 (Siddi Logs an Expense) prototype. Deliberately no entry is dated 'today' — the newest seed entry is a full day back — so a newly-saved entry (real-time timestamp) always sorts to the top of Recent Entries regardless of what time of day it's tested. entry-001 exists so the month boundary can be spot-checked. This file mirrors data/demo-data.js, which is what actually loads (see that file's header comment for why). Edit either freely — no backend, purely for prototype testing.
